Tropical Storm Warnings and Hurricane \n  Warnings are in place for offshore waters.\n\n- Hurricane Isaias is expected to make landfall on the north\n  central Gulf Coast this evening. Southeastern LA coastal areas\n  plus inland Jackson County and all of Hancock and Harrison\n  Counties MS are under a Tropical Storm Warning and coastal\n  Jackson County MS is under a Hurricane Warning. Much of coastal\n  southeast LA and coastal MS are under Storm Surge Warnings. \n\n- Potential impacts from Hurricane Isaias include blustery to\n  damaging winds, coastal flooding, and dangerous waves/seas on \n  the coastal waters.\n\n&&\n\n.SHORT TERM...\n(Now through Monday night)\nIssued at 104 PM CDT Fri Oct 9 2026\n\nStill watching Isaias and its local impacts. Associated watches\nand warnings expected to hold through tomorrow afternoon or\nevening. The only real threat here is gusty to damaging winds, had\nreports from lower Plaquemines of gusts around 50 mph and several\nreports of power outages. Heavier rain gradient is near Mobile, so\nmost we are expecting is about an inch in Jackson County and less\nthan a tenth everywhere else in the area. We are expecting storm\nsurge of 3-5 feet that could cause minor coastal flooding.\n\nOnce Isaias makes landfall this evening and moves/weakens inland\nwe still have a period of lingering 15-20mph winds through\nSaturday afternoon. There is also a slight chance of a few\nlingering very light showers through tomorrow morning. As is\ntypical of the day after a lot of tropical systems, the highlight\ntomorrow is going to be very pleasant with partly cloudy to clear\nskies, temperatures in the 80s and humidities in the 50% range.\n\nSunday into Monday the notable conditions will be a warming trend\nwith daytime highs around 90, which is about 10 degrees above\nnormal.\n\n&&\n\n.LONG TERM...\n(Tuesday through Thursday night)\nIssued at 104 PM CDT Fri Oct 9 2026\n\nHigh pressure ridging to our north maintains clear weather and\nwarm temperatures. We will continue to see daytime highs around\n90, light and variable winds, and clear skies.
